evidence: All five dimension prompts plus the injected app_context.md describe this app and contain no leftovers from other tasks. (1) Credentials: app_context.md:8-16 lists exactly the five seed accounts (seed_data.json accounts: harriet partner, dev/sian associate, gwen/paul client), with password `password123`, which matches walls-and-retention.md:3 and server.js:17. The roles and scopes are correct: Dev walled from M-12 (seed M-12 walled=[dev]), Gwen client of M-11 and M-13, Paul client of M-12. The functional, polish and visual prompts name gwen@kittle.test as the gate account (functional/prompt.md:13,72; polish/prompt.md:12,32; visual/prompt.md:20,49), and she exists with protected matters. (2) Screens: app_context.md:20 lists sign-in, the matter list with unread counts, the nested thread, reply/edit/delete/copy-link/hold controls, timer and wall controls for partners, the mentions list, search and the transcript page. Each of these is stated publicly (conversations.md Links to messages/Mentions/Unread; walls-and-retention.md:19,23,29,33,35). (3) Entities: the matter ids used in prompts and criteria are only M-11, M-12 and M-13; the emails are only the five @kittle.test accounts (grep over every judge.toml: M-11 x43, M-12 x26, M-13 x41, no others). The functional prompt's domain wording ('matter titles, message text, hold marks, timer settings and refusal reasons' :32; 'JUDGE messages, replies and edits, changed and restored timers, placed and released holds, and added and lifted walls' :73-75) fits this product. The visual prompt :49 asks the judge to review M-11, M-13 'with its nested replies' and the M-11 transcript, which matches the seed (M-13 K-9 replies to K-8) and the criteria (retention_marks M-13, transcript_page M-11). The fixed clock 2026-05-12T11:00:00Z in app_context.md:27 equals seed clock and integration.md:7. URL localhost:3000 is consistent everywhere, and the only off-machine address is typed text (example.org in safe_formatting), which app_context.md:26 explicitly covers. (4) Deliverable and mode: the functional prompt's 'Each session grades one criterion' (:72) matches functional/judge.toml mode = "individual". polish/visual 'after the functional writes' is consistent with run_suite --max-concurrent-agent 1 and the advice 'do not assume the seed state'. (5) Residue sweep: grep for hireops|colderwater|CHANGE_ME|candidate|requisition|tenant|invoice|ticket|editor|@example|acme|lorem across tests/, instruction.md and instructions/ returned nothing. Diffing against the template shows every CHANGE_ME placeholder replaced and every generic template sentence (e.g. 'the accounts under Accounts', visual 'Review plan') either replaced with Kittle-specific text or still accurate generically. Adversarial attempts: I could not find a broken app that gains credit, or a conforming app that loses it, because of a prompt inaccuracy. The prompts prescribe no routes, cookie names or wording ('Any endpoint path, payload shape or cookie name is acceptable', functional :56; 'Times shown may use any clear format', app_context :27). Minor non-defect observations: Paul is listed but not used by any criterion (accurate, harmless); visual criterion phone_chambers says 'Gwen's matter thread' without naming a matter, but the visual prompt's state section names M-11 and M-13, so any of them is accurate; raw-evidence-index.json uses image names 'cw-editor-agent-r3'/'cw-editor-verifier' (Colderwater-era naming) in QC evidence only, not in any shipped prompt, so it is outside this row.
